text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 3, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "3 hammers in June"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "4 hammers in July"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 6, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "6 hammers in August"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 9, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "9 hammers in September"}], "plan": [{"op": "sub", "args": ["q2", "q1"], "out": "s1", "note": "June-to-July increase"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q3", "q2"], "out": "s2", "note": "July-to-August increase"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q4", "q3"], "out": "s3", "note": "August-to-September increase"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s3", "s2"], "out": "s4", "note": "how much the monthly increase itself is growing"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s3", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "next month's increase, continuing the pattern"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q4", "s5"], "out": "s6", "note": "September's total plus the next increase"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "number of hammers ordered in October, continuing the pattern"}, "dismissed": []}
